request.prompt:
Edit image1 for card C03. Keep its ONE physical impact event: a depressed enemy SHIELD at the pit lip, ONE thick stone slab flipping UP beside it, and the enemy's gripping hand → short forearm → dark shoulder connected continuously. Keep the low viewpoint from the impact-pit rim, the single downward force/upward reaction relationship, and landscape25:19 format (1250 wide×950 high). Images2 C22 and3 R17 are STYLE references for complete large shapes and restraint, not poses or lightning scale.

The main repair is GRAPHIC SIMPLIFICATION AND SMALLER BEAR ARM:
Reframe/reposition the top shield rim and its contact slightly higher in the picture so the bear shows only a SHORT SMALL navy forearm load block entering from the TOP EDGE, pressing downward onto that rim. It should occupy at most around ONE SIXTH of the whole picture, never one third. Do NOT leave a detached floating paw; the small arm must continue naturally offscreen through the top. No bear head, no claw close-up, no tall vertical arm tower. The bear arm is simply navy with a small grey-white fur edge and NO lightning stripe.

Keep the enemy shield clearly distinct from the stone. Its outer rim and handhold remain visible, and the dark armored hand grips it; hand connects through a short bent enemy forearm into the same dark shoulder at the right. Do not fuse bear arm and enemy hand or create a floating severed arm. Keep one tiny muted warm-white physical compression at the bear-to-shield contact, no explosion.

The ONE upturned thick STONE SLAB remains the dominant complete physical mass, but redraw it with only THREE LARGE clean planes: warm terra-cotta top, pale grey fracture face, dark side thickness. Its continuous edge and substantial thickness stay obvious. Delete all tiny crack webbing, little chips, mottled texture, cut-up facets, and almost ALL floating pebbles; ideally no small floating debris at all. Do not add a second equal slab. Preserve the narrow lower pivot/root at the same pit.

Replace fragmented ground with TWO BROAD uninterrupted warm ground planes around ONE deep-navy pit. Remove all ground rubble, shards and little fissures. The ONLY lightning is TWO THIN modest cyan lines leaving this SINGLE PIT BOTTOM along one ground seam to the left and one to the right. No branching lightning forest, upward lightning, arm lightning, airborne bolts, rings, separate hits or large luminous white patch. These fine lines are secondary to physical weight.

Match the fixed card series: mature severe hard-edged flat fills, broad continuous blocks, 2–3 tones only, bold restrained outline, no dense fur, grain, detailed rock texture, painterly shading, soft3D volume or glow haze. No text, icons, numbers, border or UI.

plan_card.prompt:
最高风格优先级：成品卡参考的简洁图形风格优先于身份立绘的材质细节。像精炼的平面海报插画：少数连续硬边大色块，每种材质只有2至3个明暗面。不要笔触、颗粒、细密岩纹、小碎云、软质毛发和密集小切面。角色身份参考只取轮廓与特征，不复制其细碎渲染。保持严肃厚重、非幼态。

卡片：C03《轰雷重击》。创作一张新的独立插画，核心动词/关系为“重砸”。

镜头与抽象：冲击坑边缘的低机位。M2。
画面：从冲击坑边低看，一块厚石板被重击向上掀起；敌方盾缘与连接其后的握盾短臂被压低到坑沿，仍能辨出盾、臂和敌人暗肩的连续关系。上缘只露一小段熊的短前臂承力块向下压住盾面，爪不做特写。唯一接触点建立重砸，细雷从坑底沿地缝向两侧离开。

大形与负形：下陷的受击点与上翻厚石形成上下反力，主施力与受体在同一短轴上；雷线服从这个落点。
色彩：赤陶地面、深蓝坑底、灰白断面、少量冷雷。

25:19横向卡牌插画，只有画面，没有文字、标题、费用、边框或游戏UI。厚而克制的深色轮廓，硬边平涂，2—3个明暗层；少数完整大色块，背景服从唯一主读法。这是有意设计的图形概括，不用软质3D毛发、密集碎毛、体积光和粒子填充。实体角色出现时保持白灰宽肩、深蓝身体、短厚熊吻、青眼与青色短弯爪；只有场景确实露出胸部时才需要胸辫。纯环境或符号图不额外塞熊头、爪子或身份标记。用大形、留白、受力与尺度传达厚重和野性，不能把圆身摆拍、随机拉长的肢体或多余零件当作抽象。

参考用途：身份图用于确认实体角色；C22《雷震》用于主形清晰度、重量和气质；R17《天雷决》用于色块简洁或对象关系。借用这些方法，不复制它们的角色占位、动作轴或独特构图。

明确避免：又一只竖直巨爪占半幅；受体完全缺失像地形自行塌陷；漂浮敌方断手；多处雷击爆点；薄纸石块；两块等大石体夹亮缝。
图像语义：物理重击先发生，雷伤沿接触地面扩散。
只表现上述单一场面，不增加说明文字、分镜、数值图标或与主动作无关的对象。
